scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Long time no see!
Hey, you didn't quit
your business, did you?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好久不见！
嘿，你该不会不做生意了吧？
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Whoa...
You've actually been to Valhalla?! Wow, you've come a long way...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
哇...
你竟然去过瓦尔哈拉？！
真是经历了不少事啊...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmmm...
It seems that you're not ready to become a Merchant again. Go finish learning the Basic Novice Skills first.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
看来你还没准备好重新成为商人。
先去把初心者基础技能学完吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't worry, we'll always have a Merchant position open for you. Just come back when you're ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
别担心，我们始终为你留着商人的位置。
准备好了就回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I guess it's destiny that we meet like this once more. Alright. Once again, let me change you into a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
看来，我们能这样再次相遇，也是命运的安排。
好，再让我为你转职成商人吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ah~ How nostalgic. Just like old times! Alright, do your best!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
啊~真让人怀念，就像回到了从前！
好了，好好努力吧！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I'm so bored...
When will I hear from my lovely Blossom?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
^333333*叹气*^000000
好无聊啊...
什么时候才能收到我可爱的布洛森的消息呢？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there!
How do you like
being a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你好！
当商人感觉如何？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Having a way with
money certainly
has its perks,
does it not?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
善于赚钱，确实有不少好处，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
We Merchants hate people who are two faced. It's bad for business.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们商人讨厌两面三刀的人。
这样的人可做不好生意。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
People who always try to take advantage of other people by selling things at a ridiculous price just so they can make money that they'll waste are the worst.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
有些人卖东西漫天要价，总想着占别人便宜，赚来的钱却又随意挥霍。
这种人最糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Well, in any case, we only accept Novices for job changes to the Merchant class. But I appreciate your interest in what we do.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
总之，我们只接受初心者申请转职为商人。
不过，还是谢谢你对我们这一行感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there,
{0}.
Unfortunately, you failed to earn your Merchant License this time.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你好，{0}。
很遗憾，你这次没能取得商人执照。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I'll erase your records, so come back anytime when you want to reapply.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我会清除你的申请记录。
想重新申请时，随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hello there,
{0}.
I'm pleased to tell you
that I have good news!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你好，{0}。
很高兴告诉你，我有个好消息！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The Merchant Guild accepted your application. You've proven that you are fully qualified to become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
商人公会接受了你的申请。
你已经证明了自己完全有资格成为一名商人。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The only thing to take care of is your Membership Fee.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
现在只剩会费需要处理了。
你准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Pay the rest of the 500 Zeny
scripts.translation: 支付剩余的500 Zeny

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmmm...
I suppose you currently don't have enough zeny to pay the rest of your Membership fee right now.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
看来，你现在的Zeny还不够缴清剩余的会费。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ah yes...!
Now your
membership
is paid in full.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
啊，好了...！
你的会费已经全部缴清。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Please return when you have earned the 500 zeny that you need to become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
请在你赚到成为商人所需的500 Zeny后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I suppose you need some time to gather some zeny to pay your membership fee. Please come
back as soon as you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
看来，你还需要些时间筹集会费。
准备好后就尽快回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
恭喜！

scripts.text: I'm very pleased that you are joining the Merchant Guild and hope that you will play an active part in Rune-Midgarts' economy.
scripts.translation: 很高兴你加入商人公会，希望你能为卢恩·米德加兹的经济发展积极出力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
*Ahem* Aaaaand let me give you a little bit of money for delivering that message to Blossom for me.
I hope you'll help me again next time~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
*咳*还有啊，你替我把消息送给布洛森，这点钱就当是报酬。
希望下次你还愿意帮我~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The message you were supposed to deliver as per my request? You've forgotten about that? Oh well. Good work!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我托你带的消息呢？
你忘了？
好吧，算了。
干得不错！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Our goal is to control 20 % of the world's income! We're going to need young, eager people like you!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们的目标是掌握全世界20%的收入！
我们需要你这样年轻又有干劲的人！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But overall, we'll also be happy just to make loads of money.
But we all know that~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
不过，说到底，能赚大钱，我们就很开心了。
这一点大家都懂~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to the former Swordman's Association in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取送货用箱子，再送到普隆德拉的剑士协会旧址。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to the Mage Guild in Geffen.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取送货用箱子，再送到吉芬的魔法师公会。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then take it to Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取送货用箱子，再送到梦罗克。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the package from the storehouse, and then give it to the Kafra Employee stationed on Byalan Island. Her name is Blossom.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取箱子，再交给驻守拜兰岛的卡普拉职员。
她叫布洛森。

scripts.text: [Chief Mahnsoo]
scripts.translation: [首领 曼苏]

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Kafra Employee stationed near there. Her name is Blossom. Did you get all that?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到了那里，把箱子交给附近的卡普拉职员。
她叫布洛森。
都记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the Serial Number of the package is ^3355FF2485741^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the Serial Number of the package is ^3355FF2328137^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Mage Guildsman in charge. Remember, the packages Serial Number is ^3355FF2989396^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到了那里，把箱子交给负责此事的魔法师公会成员。
记住，箱子的序列号是^3355FF2989396^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, give the package to the Mage Guildsman in charge. Remember, the packages Serial Number is ^3355FF2191737^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到了那里，把箱子交给负责此事的魔法师公会成员。
记住，箱子的序列号是^3355FF2191737^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
You'll have to find Java Dullihan, the Dyemaker, so that you can deliver the product he ordered.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你需要找到染料师爪哇·杜利汉，把他订购的货物送过去。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But he's a little forgetful, so give it to one of his students. Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3012685^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
不过，他有点健忘，就交给他的学生吧。
记住，箱子的序列号是^3355FF3012685^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But he's a little forgetful, give it to one of his students. Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3487372^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
不过，他有点健忘，就交给他的学生吧。
记住，箱子的序列号是^3355FF3487372^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3318702^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember, the package's Serial Number is ^3355FF3543625^000000.

[Chief Mahnsoo]
Aaaannnnd...
Don't forget to deliver that message for me~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
还~~有...
别忘了替我带消息哦~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't forget your destination and the package's Serial Number.
You'll need to tell them
to the storekeeper.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
别忘了送货地点和箱子的序列号。
领货时，你得把这些告诉仓库管理员。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
The storehouse is in the room
to my right. There, you can talk
to the storekeeper, and he'll
help you out.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
仓库就在我右边的房间里。
找仓库管理员谈谈，他会帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
After you make the delivery, return to the storehouse and give the receipt to the storekeeper.
Then, come back
and see me.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
送完货，回仓库把收据交给仓库管理员。
然后，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Is that clear?
Alright, that's
the spirit.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
明白了吗？
好，就是这股干劲。
路上小心！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
So, what brings you to
the Merchant Association?
Is there anything
I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
什么风把你吹到商人协会来了？
有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I want to be a Merchant.
scripts.translation: 我想成为商人

scripts.text: Tell me about Merchants.
scripts.translation: 介绍一下商人

scripts.text: Tell me the requirements.
scripts.translation: 告诉我转职条件

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 没事

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Do you want to
be a Merchant?
Well...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
你想成为商人？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, you have to be a Novice with Job Level 10. Once you do that, make sure you learn all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
首先，你必须是职业等级达到10级的初心者，还要学会所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
We're not just
simple money makers!
We pride ourselves on having standards and only accepting qualified applicants!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们可不只是会赚钱！
我们有自己的标准，只接受合格的申请者，这可是我们的骄傲！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright, you'll need to fill out this application and prepare 1,000 Zeny for your Membership Fee.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好，你需要填好这份申请表，并准备1,000 Zeny作为会费。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Oh...!
If you don't have all the money,
I can just take 500 Zeny now.
You can pay the rest after you
pass the test and earn your
Merchant Guild License.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
哦...！
钱没带够的话，也可以先交500 Zeny。
通过考试、取得商人公会执照后，再把余款补齐。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
So what do you think?
Are you ready to join now?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
怎么样？
准备好现在加入了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I will.
scripts.translation: 是的，我愿意

scripts.text: Ummm, maybe later...
scripts.translation: 嗯，也许以后吧...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Let me check if you
filled out everything
on your application form...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
让我看看你的申请表是不是都填好了...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmm... 
{0}...
That's a nice name.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
{0}...
这个名字不错。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
This application will
only be registered once
the Membership Fee is paid.
How do you wish to
handle the fee?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
缴纳会费后，申请才会正式登记。
你打算怎么付？

scripts.text: Pay all 1,000 Zeny now!
scripts.translation: 现在一次性支付1,000 Zeny！

scripts.text: Two payments of 500 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 分两次支付，每次500 Zeny

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
It seems don't have enough zeny to pay all of the fee right now. Why don't you just pay 500 zeny now? Think about it.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
看来，你现在的Zeny不够一次付清会费。
不如先付500 Zeny？
考虑一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright~
That's 1,000 zeny.
Excellent, excellent.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好~1,000 Zeny收到了。
很好，很好。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Hmm...
It seems you don't have the funds to pay half of the membership fee. Please come back once you collect the zeny that you need.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
看来，你连一半的会费也付不起。
攒够所需的Zeny后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Let's see...
That's 500 Zeny. Although I don't think splitting payment is a good idea for any Merchant, it's alright since you're still learning.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
让我看看...
500 Zeny收到了。
虽然我觉得，商人分期付款可不是什么好习惯，不过你还在学习，就算了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Feel free to return anytime
when you are ready, alright?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
等你准备好了，随时欢迎回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
You don't have enough zeny now? That's no problem. Take your time and come back when you're
ready, okay?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
现在Zeny不够？
没关系，慢慢来，准备好了再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Alright, you're now on the list of applicants. Ah, before I get started let me say just one thing.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
好，你已经在申请人名单上了。
啊，开始之前，我还有句话要说。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
There are some dumb and greedy people out there who do not know what it means to be a Merchant.
I hope you won't turn out to be like them, will you?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
有些人又蠢又贪，根本不懂商人的意义。
我希望你不会变成那样，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Now, let me
explain what you
need to do for the
Merchant License Test.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
现在，我来说明商人执照考试要做些什么。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, then go to the former Swordman's Association in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取送货用箱子，再前往普隆德拉的剑士协会旧址。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then go to the Mage Guild in Geffen. When you get there, visit the Mage Guildsman in charge.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取送货用箱子，再前往吉芬的魔法师公会。
到了那里，找负责此事的魔法师公会成员。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then go to Morocc. There you must find Java Dullihan, the dyemaker.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取送货用箱子，再前往梦罗克，找到染料师爪哇·杜利汉。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, get the delivery package from the storehouse, and then give it to the Kafra Employee stationed on Byalan Island.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
先去仓库领取送货用箱子，再交给驻守拜兰岛的卡普拉职员。

scripts.text: [Chief Mahnsoo]
scripts.translation: [首领 曼苏]

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
When you get there, visit the Kafra Employee stationed there. Her name is Blossom. Did you get
all of that?
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
到了那里，找驻守当地的卡普拉职员。
她叫布洛森。
都记住了吗？

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
He's a bit forgetful, so you should probably give the package to one of his students.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
他有点健忘，所以最好把箱子交给他的学生。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Ummmm...
And I also have
a bit of a personal
request for you.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
嗯...
另外，我还有个私人的小请求。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Would you please give her this message when you deliver the package? Please~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
送箱子的时候，能替我把这条消息也带给她吗？
拜托啦~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Don't forget your destination and the package's Serial Number. You will need to tell those to the storekeeper in the storehouse to the right of me.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
别忘了送货地点和箱子的序列号。
领货时，你得把这些告诉我右边仓库里的管理员。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
After the delivery, give the receipt to the storekeeper, and then come back and see me.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
送完货，把收据交给仓库管理员，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Is that clear?
Alright, that's
the spirit.
Take care!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
明白了吗？
好，就是这股干劲。
路上小心！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Merchant?
Well, we basically sell goods to make money. That is the way
of the Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
商人？
嗯，简单说，我们就是靠卖货赚钱。
这就是商人的生存之道。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
I guess we may not be the best at fighting, and we don't have many special attacks. We've got no healing skills...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们或许不太擅长战斗，也没多少特殊的攻击招式，更没有治疗技能...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
But we can buy goods at lower prices from NPC shops and sell them at a higher price to other people~
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
但是我们可以从NPC商店低价买入货物，然后高价卖给其他人~

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Our ultimate attack skill is 'Mammonite.' The strength of Mammonite comes from the anger
when we're forced to throw away perfectly good zeny.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
我们最强的攻击技能是“金钱攻击”。
这招的威力，来自被迫扔掉辛苦赚来的Zeny时，那股心头的怒火。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Throwing away zeny like that
causes a deadly rage to well up in the heart of any Merchant!
Just thinking about it
makes my blood boil!
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
就这么扔掉Zeny，哪个商人心里不会怒火翻腾！
光是想想，我就气得血都要沸腾了！

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Anyway, we can use most
weapons except Bows, Rods, and Two-Handed Swords. But we can always sell those.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
总之，除了弓、魔杖和双手剑，大多数武器我们都能使用。
不过，用不了的武器，我们也可以卖嘛。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Yes...
We Merchants generally
have money on our minds...
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
没错...
我们商人啊，脑子里想的通常都是钱...

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
There are three conditions that must be fulfilled before you can become a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
要成为商人，必须满足三个条件。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
First, You have to be a Novice with Job Level 10, and have learned all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
第一，你必须是职业等级达到10级的初心者，并学会所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Second, You have to pay a 1,000 Zeny Membership Fee. I believe any Merchant candidate should be able to earn 1,000 Zeny with ease.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
第二，缴纳1,000 Zeny的会费。
我相信，想成为商人的人，赚这1,000 Zeny应该轻而易举。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Third, there is a License Test to test your physical strength and sense of direction. You will deliver a package to a specific person in a specific location.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
第三，通过考验体力和方向感的执照考试。
你需要把箱子送到指定地点，交给指定的人。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember...
The package's
Serial Number is
^3355FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
记住...
箱子的序列号是^3355FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chief Mahnsoo]
Remember...
The package's
Serial Number is
^3355FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[首领 曼苏]
记住...
箱子的序列号是^3355FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Heya pal.
How ya doin'?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，伙计。
最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey you. We don't have any open positions for part time work. If you wanna earn some zeny, you'll hafta look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，我们这儿没有兼职空缺。
想赚Zeny的话，得去别处找找。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey you. Yeah, you.
If you wanna restart the test, go visit Mahnsoo in the other room. Then we can talk.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，你，对，就是你。
想重新考试，就去另一个房间找曼苏。
办完了，我们再谈。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright! Everything looks perfect! I'll report your success to the guildmaster. Now go talk to Chief Mahnsoo, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
好！
一切都没问题，我会向公会会长报告你通过了考试。
现在去找曼苏首领吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Oh, yeah? Okay, lemme check. Your name is {0}? Alright, your destination was...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哦，好，让我查查。
你叫{0}？
嗯，你的送货地点是...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Wow! You met the Kafra babe in Prontera?! Lucky you~ ...Receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哇！
你见到普隆德拉那位卡普拉美女了？！
真走运啊~
...收据呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Geffen Magic Academy. Okay, receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
吉芬魔法学院。
好，收据呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
The dyemaker in Morocc. Not bad. Receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
梦罗克的染料师。
不错，收据呢？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Oh hohohoho~! The Kafra Babe on Byalan Island?! Awesome! Anyway, did you bring the receipt?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哦呵呵呵呵~！
拜兰岛的卡普拉美女？！
太棒了！
对了，收据带回来了吗？

scripts.text: [Union Staff Kay]
scripts.translation: [联盟职员 凯]

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Wait a sec.
Where's the receipt?
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
等等，收据呢？
怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
If you don't have the receipt, you fail the test! You better talk to Mahnsoo if you wanna retake it, alright? Pay attention next time!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
没有收据，就算考试失败！
想重考就去找曼苏，好吗？
下次可得留心！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
...Great! Everything's perfect! I'll report your success to the Guildmaster. You should talk to Chief Mahnsoo now, alright?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
...太好了！
一切都没问题，我会向公会会长报告你通过了考试。
现在去找曼苏首领吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay] 
Huh?
You're back?
So how did
the delivery go?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
咦，你回来了？
货送得怎么样？

scripts.text: *Sob* I lost the package.
scripts.translation: *抽泣*我把箱子弄丢了

scripts.text: Fine.
scripts.translation: 很顺利

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you kidding me? You'll fail the test if you lose the package!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你开玩笑吧？
箱子弄丢了，考试就失败了！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Awwww man. Well, if you wanna restart the test, talk to Mahnsoo, okay? You're lucky you're getting another chance!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
哎呀，真是的。
想重新考试就去找曼苏，好吗？
还能再给你一次机会，算你走运！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh...
Okay...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嗯...
好吧...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey, what are you still doing here? Shouldn't you be on your way already?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，你怎么还在这里？你不该已经出发了吗？

scripts.text: I need a new package.
scripts.translation: 我需要一个新箱子

scripts.text: Oh, yeah. You're right!
scripts.translation: 哦，对。你说得对！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Wha--?
So where did
the package go?
Where is it?!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
什...什么？
箱子去哪儿了？
在哪儿？！

scripts.text: *Sob* I lost it!
scripts.translation: *抽泣*我弄丢了！

scripts.text: I have it right here.
scripts.translation: 就在我这里

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
You...
Lost it?!
You failed the test!
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你...弄丢了？！
考试失败！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
*Sigh* If you want to restart the test, go visit Mahnsoo in the other room, alright?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
*叹气*想重考的话，就去另一个房间找曼苏，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh.
I thought
you lost it.
You don't
need a new one.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
啊，我还以为你弄丢了呢。
既然还在，就不需要新的了。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
*Sigh* Man, you're starting to become a pain in the ass. Hold on, lemme cancel your record...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
*叹气*真是的，你可真够麻烦的。
等一下，我把你的记录取消...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
I need some time to get everything in order, so come back later.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
我得花点时间整理，晚些再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
What a bummer...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
真扫兴...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey there.
what brings
you here?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，找我什么事？

scripts.text: My Merchant License test.
scripts.translation: 我来参加商人执照考试

scripts.text: I'm looking for part time work.
scripts.translation: 我想找份兼职

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没事

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
I see.
Alright.
So what's
your name?
{0}...?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
明白了。
你叫什么名字？
{0}...？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Huh. Your name's not on my list. Did you apply for the job change quest or what?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
咦，名单上没有你的名字。
你到底有没有申请转职？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
You gotta apply first by talking to Chief Mahnsoo in the center
of this building, okay?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你得先找这栋楼中央的曼苏首领申请，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright, there you go. Lemme give you the package. Now, choose the destination of the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
好，我把箱子给你。
先选一下送货地点。

scripts.text: Prontera.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Geffen.
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Morocc.
scripts.translation: 梦罗克

scripts.text: Byalan Island.
scripts.translation: 拜兰岛

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Okay, now you need to give me the package's Serial Number. If you wanna cancel, just enter '0', alright?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
好，现在告诉我箱子的序列号。
想取消的话，就输入“0”，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you sure that you wanna cancel?
Alright, we'll cancel for now.
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
确定要取消？
好，那就先取消吧。

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Are you sure that you wanna cancel?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你确定要取消吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Let me try again.
scripts.translation: 让我再试一次

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Hey hey. That number's not valid! Enter a value from 1000000 to 5000000. got it?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
嘿，这个号码无效！
请输入1000000到5000000之间的数值，明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Prontera. The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
送货地点是普隆德拉，序列号是{0}。
确定没错？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Geffen. Phew! That's really far! The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
送货地点是吉芬。
呼，真够远的！
序列号是{0}，确定没错？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Destination is Morocc. That's pretty far away! The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
送货地点是梦罗克，挺远的啊！
序列号是{0}，确定没错？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Lucky you! Your destination is Byalan Island. The Serial Number is {0}. Are you positive?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
你真走运！
送货地点是拜兰岛，序列号是{0}。
确定没错？

scripts.text: Positive.
scripts.translation: 确定

scripts.text: Whoops! Wrong number!
scripts.translation: 哎呀！号码错了！

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Alright. Take this package and guard it with your life until it's safely delivered to the customer. Don't lose this thing, got it?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
好，拿着这个箱子，拼了命也得护好，直到安全送到客户手里。
别弄丢了，明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Well then, I wish you luck. Remember, you gotta bring me
a receipt once you finish the delivery, okay?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
祝你好运。
记住，送完货一定要把收据带回来给我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Part time job? Sorry pal, no jobs yet. The Paymaster's department can never balance our budget...
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
兼职？
抱歉，伙计，目前没有空缺。
财务部门连预算都平衡不了...

scripts.text:
[Union Staff Kay]
Nothing, eh?
I guess you enjoy
bothering people for
no reason then, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[联盟职员 凯]
没事？
那你就是喜欢没事打扰别人喽？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
You're from
the Merchant Guild?
Yes! You've come to
the right place.
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
您是商人公会派来的？
没错，您来对地方了！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
But...
Where's the
package I ordered?
That's strange...
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
可是...
我订的箱子呢？
真奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Okay~
Please set the
package down
over there.
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
好~请把箱子放在那边。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Let me check the Serial Number of the package so I can give you the receipt, okay?
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
我先核对一下箱子的序列号，再给您收据，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3012685. See?
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
抱歉，不过...
这好像不是我们订的箱子。
序列号应该是3012685，您看？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3487372. See?
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
抱歉，不过...
这好像不是我们订的箱子。
序列号应该是3487372，您看？

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Excuse me, but...
I don't think this is the package we ordered. The Serial Number should be 3012685 or 3487372. Well, one of those two...
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
抱歉，不过...
这好像不是我们订的箱子。
序列号应该是3012685或3487372。
嗯，这两个号码中的一个...

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
3012685...
That's right.
Here's your
receipt.
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
3012685...
没错，这是您的收据。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
3487372...
That's right.
Here's your
receipt.
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
3487372...
没错，这是您的收据。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Thanks a lot!
See you again
sometime!
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
非常感谢！
有机会再见！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Oh...
You're gonna
go back? Okay
then, take care!
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
哦，您要回去了？
那好，路上小心！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Mr. Java Dullihan is the one and only, the best dye maker on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
爪哇·杜利汉先生是米德加尔特大陆上独一无二、最出色的染料师。

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Aaaand I'm proud to say that I'm his student! Someday, I'll be able to make really beautiful dyes too!
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
而~~且，我可是他的学生，真是太自豪了！
总有一天，我也能做出非常漂亮的染料！

scripts.text:
[Dyer's Student]
Of course, I'm still learning the basics right now, but someday...
scripts.translation:
[染料师的学徒]
当然，现在我还在学基础，不过，总有一天...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Ah, you must be with the Merchant Guild. Finally, my package has arrived! Alright...!
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
啊，您是商人公会派来的吧。
我的箱子终于到了！
太好了...！

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Wait...
Where's the
package?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
等等...
箱子呢？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
You must be very tired
from having to travel
in this kind
of weather...
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
这种天气还要赶路，您一定累坏了...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
Uh oh, this is the wrong number. This isn't what we ordered...
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
好，让我核对一下序列号...
哎呀，号码不对，这不是我们订的货...

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
2989396. Yes, this is what we ordered. Here is your receipt.
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
好，让我核对一下序列号...
2989396，没错，这是我们订的货。
这是您的收据。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Alright, let me
check the Serial Number...
2191737. Yes, this is what we ordered. Here is your receipt.
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
好，让我核对一下序列号...
2191737，没错，这是我们订的货。
这是您的收据。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2989396.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
序列号应该是2989396。
您看！
没发现哪里不对吗？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2191737.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
序列号应该是2191737。
您看！
没发现哪里不对吗？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
The Serial Number
should be 2989396
or 2191737, one of
those two.
Look here!
Don't you see
something
is wrong?
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
序列号应该是2989396或2191737，这两个号码中的一个。
您看！
没发现哪里不对吗？

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Heh heh~
Thank you!
Bye bye!
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
呵呵~
谢谢！
再见！

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
Hello,
Merchant Guildsman~
I give you my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
你好，商人公会的朋友~
真是谢谢你了。

scripts.text:
[Guild Staff]
My package should have arrived by now. Huh. I guess the Merchant Guild might be running a little late...
scripts.translation:
[公会职员]
我的箱子该到了吧。
嗯，看来商人公会有点耽搁了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh! Thank you for
traveling such a long
way to come over here~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦！
谢谢您大老远赶来~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
A delivery from
the Merchant Guild?
Oh, yes, please set
it down right over there...
W-wait. Didn't you bring it?
Where's the package?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
商人公会送来的货？
哦，好，请放在那边...
等、等等，您没带来吗？
箱子呢？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
A delivery from
the Merchant Guild?
Oh, yes, please set
it down right over there...
You must be really tired
after carrying it for so long!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
商人公会送来的货？
哦，好，请放在那边...
搬着箱子走这么远，您一定累坏了！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Now, let me check
the serial number...
2485741. Right, this is
the one we ordered. Oh,
and don't forget this receipt!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
让我核对一下序列号...
2485741，没错，这是我们订的货。
哦，别忘了拿好这张收据！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Now, let me check
the serial number...
2328137. Right, this is
the one we ordered. Oh,
and don't forget this receipt!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
让我核对一下序列号...
2328137，没错，这是我们订的货。
哦，别忘了拿好这张收据！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm afraid there
must be some kind
of mistake. Perhaps
you should go back to
the Merchant Guild to
clear up this situation?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
恐怕是哪里出了差错。
您不妨回商人公会确认一下？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Thanks again
for going through
all of that trouble~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
再次感谢您费心了~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to the
Kafra Corportation,
where the service is
always on your side~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
欢迎光临卡普拉公司，我们的服务永远在您身边~

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
As you can see, the
Swordman Assocation
has moved to Izlude, a
satellite city of Prontera.
Currently, we offer a Teleport
Service to Izlude for 600 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
如您所见，剑士协会已经搬到普隆德拉的卫星城市依斯鲁得了。
目前，我们提供前往依斯鲁得的传送服务，费用为600 Zeny。

scripts.text: Use
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough zeny
for this Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足以支付这项传送服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh hello~
Um, is there
some special reason
as to why you're here?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦，您好~
嗯，您来这里有什么特别的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
A delivery from
the Merchant Guild?
Oh, yes, please set
it down right over there...
W-wait. Didn't you bring it?
Where's the package?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
商人公会送来的货？
哦，好，请放在那边...
等、等等，您没带来吗？
箱子呢？

scripts.text: This is from Chief Mahnsoo of the Merchant Guild...
scripts.translation: 这是商人公会曼苏首领托我带来的...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh~! A letter from
Mahnsoo! Thank you
so much, I've been dying
to hear from him. How is
he doing, is he alright?
I can't wait to read it...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
哦~！
曼苏的信！
真是太感谢您了，我一直盼着他的消息呢。
他最近怎么样，还好吗？
我都等不及要读了...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Oh, thank you for
going through all the
trouble of delivering all
of this. This isn't anything
special, but please take it.
Well, see you again~
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 职员]
谢谢您费心把这些东西送来。
这不是什么贵重的东西，还请收下。
那么，下次再见~
